expected.fmt:
import expect_true from "@std/test/test.ms"

fn halve(n: Int) Int?:
	if n % 2 != 0: return none
	return (n / 2)

fn parse(n: Int) Int!Error:
	if n < 0: return error(cause: Error("negative"))
	return ok(value: n)

fn matched(n: Int) Int:
	found := halve(n: n)

	match found:
		v:
			return v
		none:
			return 0 - 1

fn twice(n: Int) Int:
	found := halve(n: n)
	var total = 0

	match found:
		v:
			total += v
		none:
			total += 100

	match found:
		v:
			total += v
		none:
			total += 1000

	return total

fn results(n: Int) String:
	parsed := parse(n: n)

	match parsed:
		ok(v):
			return "ok {v}"
		error(cause):
			return cause.message

fn formatted(n: Int) String:
	found := halve(n: n)
	return "{found}"

fn captured(n: Int) Int:
	found := halve(n: n)
	read := fn() Int:
		match found:
			v:
				return v
			none:
				return 0 - 1
	return read()

test "typed alternative lets":
	expect_true((matched(n: 8) == 4))?
	expect_true((matched(n: 7) == 0 - 1))?
	expect_true((twice(n: 8) == 8))?
	expect_true((twice(n: 7) == 1100))?
	expect_true((results(n: 3) == "ok 3"))?
	expect_true((results(n: 0 - 3) == "negative"))?
	expect_true((formatted(n: 8) == formatted(n: 8)))?
	expect_true((captured(n: 8) == 4))?
	expect_true((captured(n: 7) == 0 - 1))?
